backstory.ex_soldier.desc: The war is over. Not quite, for you.
backstory.ex_soldier.life: You held the line under arrows, looted wagons and buried your own. The pay never came; what stayed is a spear, a gambeson and a sleep you wake from with a knife in hand. People are wary of you.
backstory.ex_soldier.name: Former soldier
backstory.herbalist.desc: Every herb is a cure. Or a poison.
backstory.herbalist.life: An old woman at the village edge taught you: which root for fever, what to sear a wound with, how to bring a child. People come to you in trouble, and whisper about witchcraft behind your back.
backstory.herbalist.name: Herbalist
backstory.hunter.desc: The forest feeds those who can wait.
backstory.hunter.life: You have spent more time in the thicket than among people. You read tracks, set snares and dress a carcass in the frost. The village respects you but does not ask you to its table.
backstory.hunter.name: Hunter
backstory.novice.desc: Prayer, fasting and other people's sins in confession.
backstory.novice.life: You were given to the cloister as a child. You know letters, psalms and the herbs of the monastery garden, and the world beyond the wall more from confessions than from life. Now you have come back to your own.
backstory.novice.name: Novice
backstory.peasant.desc: Soil, cattle and a long memory of lean years.
backstory.peasant.life: You grew up behind the plough and the flail. You know when to sow and when to pray for rain, and how to make bread last till spring. Your kin are near and the neighbours know your face.
backstory.peasant.name: Peasant
backstory.smith_apprentice.life: Years at another man's forge: charcoal, bellows, tongs and a master quick with his fist. You have no smithy of your own yet, but the hammer already obeys you.
backstory.smith_apprentice.name: Smith's apprentice
backstory.trader.desc: Everything has a price. Everyone, too.
backstory.trader.life: You drove carts from fair to fair, haggled in three tongues and cheated when there was no other way. You carry a fat purse and goods, and no trust in the village yet.
backstory.trader.name: Trader
backstory.vagrant.desc: No roof, no field, no debts.
backstory.vagrant.life: You slept in ditches and haylofts, ate what you found and left before the farmer missed his hen. Your kin disowned you long ago. The road taught you to live anywhere.
backstory.vagrant.name: Vagrant
hud.backstory.start.home: At home, by your own hearth
hud.backstory.start.road: On the road to the village
hud.backstory.start.village_edge: At the edge of the village
hud.backstory.start.wilds: In the wilds, far from people
hud.backstory.subtitle: Your past decides what you bring into this valley.
hud.backstory.title: Who were you before?
